description:
- 10-15 minutes to all the excitement of Broadway and Downtown Nashville
- Private balcony with comfortable outdoor seating
- Four bedrooms, primary features an attached ensuite

The space
The Last Rodeo Suite 3 – The Ultimate Bachelorette Retreat in Nashville!

Your dream girls' getaway starts here! Just a quick 10-15-minute rideshare from Downtown and Broadway, The Last Rodeo Suite 3 is designed for unforgettable moments, photo ops, and all the pink, glam, and fun your group could ask for.

Highlights You'll Love:
- The Glam Room – Get ready in style with a dedicated space for hair, makeup, and those perfect pre-party selfies.
- Communal Rooftop with Skyline Views – Sip cocktails with your crew as you take in the sparkling Nashville skyline.
- Chic, Pink, & Playful Decor – A fun, feminine aesthetic that sets the perfect vibe for your bachelorette bash.

The Space:
Inside, you'll find a stylish four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom retreat designed for comfort, connection, and celebration. The living room is perfect for group hangs with a cozy sofa and smart TV, while the fully equipped kitchen makes it easy to whip up brunch or mix up mimosas. Barstool seating and a dining table for six mean there's room for everyone to gather.

Upstairs, a secondary lounge area with extra sofas and another TV gives you even more space to relax—whether you're winding down after a night out or queuing up a rom-com marathon.

Sweet Dreams Await:
- Primary Suite – A luxe escape with an ensuite bathroom for added privacy.
- Three Additional Bedrooms – Stylish and comfy, perfect for your whole squad.
- Bonus Bunk Room – Ideal for late-night chats and making memories with your besties.
- Whether you're here for the honky-tonk nights, rooftop cocktails, or glam squad selfies, The Last Rodeo Suite 3 is designed for unforgettable moments and nonstop fun.

Book now, and let the party begin!

East Nashville is one of Nashville's oldest neighborhoods, located just across the Cumberland River. Known for its eclectic and artsy atmosphere, you'll find some of the city's best restaurants, live music venues, shopping, and easy access to Nissan Stadium. Bonus: all of the excitement of Broadway is just a 10-minute Uber drive away. Don't be surprised if you see one of your favorite musicians walking around this neighborhood, as many of them call it home!

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!
